periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Primary axis oriented at a downward diagonal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal muzzle axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Vertically elongated oval with a height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward extension where the distance from the geometric center to the inferior margin is significantly greater than to the superior margin.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Posterior edge exhibits a broad and relatively flat U-shaped profile across the dorsal region.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, occupying approximately 40-50% of the visible torso length between the neck and the lower back.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A distinct white gap approximately 1.5 times the width of a single ear base separates the dark pinnae regions.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, semi-circular curvature along the superior margins of both ears.
